text:
tomo: Starting hotfix 2.4.3 canary rollout in change window (23:00-00:00 UTC). Deploybot will monitor. Auto-rollback thresholds: p95 > 220ms OR error_rate > 1.5% over 2m. I'll tag release notes update once we confirm.

deploybot: Canary rollout started for release 2.4.3 -> canary pool. Monitoring: p95 latency, error_rate, kv-cache miss rate. Alerts forwarded to #eng-oncall.

maya: :eyes: Noting staging showed a small embedding drift vs prod on the eval set. Recommend adding a generation-quality gate tied to the eval dashboard (link: https://dashboard/redwood/evals).

alex: If we need to rollback for customers we should be ready to pin v2.4.2 for Dedicated and Hosted. Also please flag tokenization change in release notes.

david: Manual rollback quick steps (rehearsed):
1) pin stable: `redwoodctl pin release --pool canary --version v2.4.2`
2) scale down new tasks: `kubectl -n redwood scale deployment canary-release --replicas=0`
3) verify traffic back to v2.4.2, then post status to #customer-comms
I'll be on standby to run these if needed.

rachel: Support ops standing by for inbound tickets. Draft comms: "We rolled back briefly to the previous stable version while we investigate a transient latency spike." Ready for sign-off.

deploybot: ALERT: canary p95 latency crossed 230ms for 3m. Auto-rollback conditions met. Auto-rollback will start in 30s unless the release owner issues a manual hold.

tomo: Holding auto-rollback — issuing manual override. Reason: telemetry looks noisy; there was an internal perf test hitting canary at 10x load. Maya can you confirm?

maya: Confirmed noise — background perf test (job/ablation-run-312) was the cause, unrelated to model change. :thumbsup: Recommend canceling rollback and continuing rollout.

deploybot: Auto-rollback canceled by override from tomo. Rollout resumed. Will keep monitoring and will pin if manual rollback is requested. Logs: https://logs.redwood/canary/1739102468

alex: I'll update release notes with a short note about the transient spike and notify enterprise customers proactively. Thanks all.
